The '''Biskaran Pirates'''<ref name="EGTW" /> originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Biskar system/Legends|Biskar system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], they launched the [[siege of Niele]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by the [[Judicial/Legends|Judicial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] broke the siege, although in the process he lost an [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to a Biskaran [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] armed with a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Biskaran Pirates were introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
